notes.title: Achievements!
notes.content:
Xenia patch 1.09 with achievements!

10 achievements to increase your profile score.

We are proud to announce one of the final patches which adds achievements to the game!

We have added 10 achievements which have to do with boss fights and game completion. Feel free to look for them. Who is going to get them first? Let's see!

Will you be the first to unlock "Real-life Ardas" achievement?

Good luck adventurers.
